answer.because: On head, loadAll('a\n\uFEFF---\nb') gives one scalar 'a \uFEFF--- b' where base gives ['a','b'], and a block scalar followed by a BOM-prefixed '---' throws 'document separator is expected'. This shows that a BOM before a later document's separator no longer ends the scalar or the document.

why: On head, loadAll('a\n\uFEFF---\nb') gives one scalar 'a \uFEFF--- b' where base gives ['a','b'], and a block scalar followed by a BOM-prefixed '---' throws 'document separator is expected'. This shows that a BOM before a later document's separator no longer ends the scalar or the document.
